description: A scrumptious selection of 250 healthy, (mostly) vegetarian recipes from the restaurant that "has elevated meatless cooking to the level of great cuisine" (James Peterson, James Beard Award–winning author of Sauces ). Moosewood Restaurant, founded in 1973, revolutionized vegetarian cooking by introducing delicious soups, satisfying sandwiches, warming casseroles, zesty entrees, spiffy salads, and divine desserts. Moosewood Restaurant Favorites contains 250 of their most requested recipes completely updated and revised to reflect the way they're cooked now—increasingly vegan and gluten-free, benefiting from fresh herbs, new varieties of vegetables, and the wholesome goodness of newly rediscovered grains. description: Craving your favorite restaurant meals but not the prices, long lines, or mystery ingredients? Secret Recipes – Restaurant Favorites: Copycat Favorites You Can Make at Home — Iconic Fast Food, Takeout & Restaurant Classics Made Simplebrings the flavors you love straight into your own kitchen. This cookbook is your all-access pass to recreating the dishes you order again and again—from fast food indulgences and takeout staples to beloved restaurant classics—using simple ingredients and clear, step-by-step techniques. Inside, you’ll discover how to replicate the bold flavors, satisfying textures, and crave-worthy finishes that make restaurant food so irresistible. Think juicy burgers with perfectly seasoned fries, creamy pasta dishes, savory stir-fries, fresh salads, and decadent desserts—all made from scratch and tailored to your taste. Each recipe is designed not just to copy the original, but to capture what makes it memorable, so every bite feels familiar and satisfying. But this book goes beyond imitation. You’ll learn the key techniques that restaurants use to elevate everyday dishes—how to layer flavors, balance seasoning, and finish meals with that extra touch that makes all the difference. Once you understand these fundamentals, you’ll be able to customize recipes, adjust flavors, and even improve on the originals. Whether you’re cooking for your family, entertaining guests, or simply satisfying a personal craving, this cookbook makes it easy to bring restaurant-quality meals to your table. No reservations required. No drive-thru needed. Just great food, made at home, exactly the way you like it. Whether you are planning a casual family dinner, game-day spread, weekend gathering, date-night meal, or fun restaurant-inspired menu at home, this cookbook gives you practical recipes with approachable ingredients and satisfying results. From crispy honey chicken and coconut shrimp to baked potato soup, cheeseburger egg rolls, smoky wings, bruschetta, burgers, cookies, beignets, and indulgent bread pudding, every page is designed to help you enjoy bold, familiar, crowd-pleasing flavors from the comfort of your kitchen. description: The ketogenic diet has taken the world by storm, and deservedly so: its results in helping people lose weight, manage chronic health conditions, and simply feel great are unmatched. Bestselling cookbook author Maria Emmerich sits at the forefront of the keto movement and has become the go-to source for high-fat, low-carb recipes that both please the palate and nourish the body. With Keto Restaurant Favorites, Maria delivers once again by putting a new and unprecedented twist on ketogenic cooking. Eating keto doesn’t mean that you have to give up the dishes you love! Instead, Maria shows you how to recreate those recipes, keto-style. Keto Restaurant Favorites answers the demand for a one-stop cookbook that allows you to easily replicate your favorite restaurant cuisine in your own kitchen. Maria’s recipes masterfully mimic the dishes you love using healthy, readily accessible ingredients. In addition to classic American fare, this book offers recipes for a variety of cuisines, including Italian, Chinese, Mexican, and Thai. Maria even includes favorites from the kids’ menu! Recipes include: Bacon Cheeseburger Copycat Frosty Corn dogs Curry Pho Tom ka gai Carne asada Gnocchi Calzones Cannoli General Tso’s And many more! With nearly 170 recipes covering a broad spectrum of restaurant cuisine, Keto Restaurant Favorites is sure to please even the pickiest eaters. Say goodbye to feeling deprived!
